text:
emily: Opening a follow-up thread for the small-but-steady memory drift impacting prod-kv (hot shards). saw first rise ~07:10 UTC, no customer errors yet but trend is concerning.
marc: thanks. symptoms? OOMs or just residency growth?
emily: residency grows slowly; jemalloc metrics show rising fragmentation + more 32B-64B objects over hours.
rachel: uploaded two heap snapshots and jemalloc timelines: gs://redwood/prof/2473005555/snapshots.tar.gz. I'll run diffs later today.
lee: quick look earlier pointed to encoder.buffer allocations in persist layer, specifically indexEntry slices not being returned promptly.
nora: for PCI shards we should be careful with evictions. pre-approve any eviction bump with support comms.
ops-bot: canary "pool-and-compact-probe" started at 2473005660 (shards 5/20).
emily: proposed action items (owners + targets): 1) full diff + flamegraphs -> @rachel -> Thurs EOD; 2) microbench pooling PR -> @lee -> PR by tomorrow AM; 3) jemalloc arena/tune canary -> @marc -> metrics by Fri; 4) soft-residency design (per-shard, percentile) -> @emily -> draft Wed.
marc: noted. jemalloc tune experiments: trying reduced lg_dirty_mult and aggressive purge on canary. will publish results.
lee: pooling sketch: use sync.Pool for index entry buffers and ensure release on all return paths. low-code-change. risk: must avoid retaining buffers across shard handoffs.
rachel: diff preliminary: +22k extra small objects attributed to persist.encoder -> encoder.go:118. flamegraph: gs://redwood/prof/2473005555/flame.svg.
emily: pairing plan: lee+ rachel will validate pooling reduces alloc churn; marc will run jemalloc canary; if both good, roll pooling to 10% then 50%.
nora: i'll draft a two-line customer note for support in case we need eviction ramp; also set alert for p95 seq_len>900 && residency_ratio>1.2.
marc: creating tickets: RI-2801 (pooling PR), RI-2802 (jemalloc-canary), RI-2803 (soft-residency design). assigning due dates in tracking sheet.
ops-bot: RI-2801 assigned to lee, due 2027-04-06.
lee: opened branch feat/pool-indexentry-2473, bench shows ~34% lower alloc rate on local harness. will add tests and PR.
rachel: note: if pooling reduces alloc rate but residency remains high, plan B = increase compact cadence + targeted eviction for sequences above threshold.
emily: weekly sync scheduled Fri 09:00 PT to close outstanding actions and confirm no regression. I'll update the incident postmortem with owners/timelines today. cc @lee @marc @rachel
marc: will post jemalloc metrics and fragmentation counters to the dashboard link after canary completes.
nora: thanks team. logging the communication plan in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/kv-remediation-plan.
